description: Returns reaffirm.mjs, the ready-to-edit harness that re-proves the app's boundaries against live Gemmein on every deploy (also shipped inside the @gemmein/sdk package): copied next to the app with its CONFIG block set, it runs in CI. Useful when wiring up the app's CI or handing over the finished app. check_integration runs the same checks once, with no file to install.
name: reaffirm_template
title: Reaffirm template
